scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.bench:quotes: npm run build -w server && node --experimental-strip-types server/scripts/bench-quotes.ts
scripts.bench:public-feed: npm run build -w server && node --experimental-strip-types server/scripts/bench-public-feed.ts
